body:
Reduces the growing-radix precision guard for PR628's neighboring cyclic inverse from **O(r^4) to O(r^3)**. Every partial inverse is bounded by the full inverse and its complementary polynomial, using the standard Mahler-measure inequality. Bounding all rounded prefixes together avoids multiplying the worst reciprocal margin once per factor. PR621's circle bound is unchanged.

The written proof gives `W <= max(p,w)+12r^3+m` fractional bits for a source of norm at most `2^m`, including exact coarse-grid source recovery, and a factor-preparation budget `b <= p+6r^3+m`. Integer magnitude bits have the same cubic order. With the inherited preparation algorithms, neighboring-layout execution and setup cost `soft-O((Lr+r^3)(max(p,w)+r^3+m))`, plus charged phase access and longer phase descriptions.

The new in-place schedule evaluates the inverse, adds its result to a target, applies the forward factors, and rounds the source back to its original grid exactly. This requires **owned widened words with reserved low zero bits**, whose capacity is explicitly charged. Rounding the target increment to the original grid also gives signed shears that compose and cancel exactly with one fixed precision budget for a planned word.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/cubic-cyclic-inverse/run.py --out /absolute/fresh/output
```

Validation:

- 5,220 exact integer budget cases across all 116 prime-power radices from 3 through 512.
- 120 actual kernel executions; 60 compare every prefix with independent dense solves. All check expanded polynomial residuals, recovery bounds, exact source restoration and total kernel error at most `2^-128`.
- 20 interacting shear-word cases, including 12 dense comparisons and exact whole-word cancellation; ten rejection controls across both suites.
- Complete fresh runs passed on macOS/Python 3.11 and 3.14 and Linux aarch64/Python 3.14, in approximately 66–72 seconds. All three generated mathematical artifacts are byte-identical. Receipts, logs, source manifests and artifact hashes are included. Scoped Python 3.11/3.14 CI is added.

**No new κ, complex b, BIT c or measured multiplication speedup.** The asymptotic claim comes from the written argument; finite tests do not implement Pan's worst-case factorizer. Arbitrary dirty-bit restoration, common-label/Clifford compilation, arbitrary-stride restored-source scheduling, complete-transform accounting and the multiplication reduction remain open. The full repository suite and selected supplier were not rerun for this isolated package.

Credit Ali Romman for #621, Chafik Boukhalfa for #628, and the standard Mahler-measure, periodic-filtering and approximate-factorization methods. Exact predecessor heads, blobs, notices and mathematical sources are retained. Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human or delegated-agent review, formal verification or literature-priority claim.
title: Research: cubic precision and exact coarse-grid recovery for cyclic inverses (no κ)
